purpose: Research candidate pools for a later random starting-bank feature; no player progress or application behavior changed.

policy.optionA: Fixed bank services made available by membership; ordinary walking or retained F2P transport; all F2P quests completed; no members quest or members-only skill prerequisite. Unknown finishing levels, achievements, payments, builds, roaming banker presence and members transports are separate conditional lists.
policy.optionB: Havenhythe full banks usable after F2P preparation. Wendlewick is baseline; Dalia requires confirmation of the F2P Trader Woes achievement. Members-quest banks are inventory only until their gates are satisfied.
policy.chunkIdMeaning: Displayed surface chunk containing bank, or explicitly named surface entry parent for a connected interior. Interior source-region IDs and cache map IDs are not interchangeable with these IDs.
policy.weighting: Roll unique chunkId values. Multiple services within the same chunk do not add weight unless deliberately chosen.
policy.personalEligibility: Check each player independently. F2P completion does not prove maximum skill levels or every achievement.
